questions.question: C14 says a tampered node/block/pin set must be refused. But the request is client-held, so the server cannot tell tampering from another perfectly valid line in the same statement. Re-deriving scope proves the user is allowed the data; it does NOT prove the question is about the screen. How strong should that guarantee be?

The docked assistant and /ask share one AskProvider, so turns survive navigation. A grounded explanation could therefore appear on /ask — which you said must stay exactly as today. What should happen to grounded turns when the user leaves the MIS screen?
options: Let grounded turns stay visible in the thread
